name: Can you repair damaged cabinet doors and drawers during refinishing?

mainEntity.name: Can you repair damaged cabinet doors and drawers during refinishing?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes, cabinet repair is often integrated into the refinishing process. We can address common issues such as loose hinges, minor dings, scratches, and delaminated areas before applying a new finish. For more significant structural damage, we assess whether repair is feasible and cost-effective compared to replacement components. This approach ensures a cohesive and durable result for your restored cabinets.
acceptedAnswer.description: Yes, minor damage like dings, scratches, and loose hinges can be repaired during the refinishing process.
